description: The Gujarat government is preparing a pilot AI project for Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation to identify stray cattle and their owners using CCTV feeds and biometric analysis. The initiative aims to improve traffic safety and strengthen AI-driven governance
body_lead: Home |India |Gujarat Plans Ai Based System To Manage Stray Cattle In Cities Gujarat plans AI-based system to manage stray cattle in cities The Gujarat government is preparing a pilot AI project for Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation to identify stray cattle and their owners using CCTV feeds and biometric analysis.
